description: This file implements classes and methods for managing user equipment (UE) slices within a radio access network (RAN), including adding/removing UEs and logical channels, and calculating pending uplink bytes.

classes.name: slice_ue
classes.description: Represents a user equipment (UE) within a specific RAN slice, managing its logical channels and pending data.

classes.name: slice_ue_repository
classes.description: Manages a collection of UEs within a specific RAN slice, allowing addition, removal, and logical channel management.

methods.name: slice_ue::pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates the number of new bytes pending for uplink transmission for this UE slice.
